faq_heading: North Delta houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a North Delta house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 35 houses with a legal suite that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $1,400,000, with the middle half between $1,292,500 and $1,761,190. Every North Delta detached house had a median of $1,225,000.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in North Delta?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 35 North Delta houses sold with a legal suite and 44 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $1,177,500.

faq.q: When did Delta adopt its small-scale housing rules?
Can a North Delta lot have a suite and a coach house?
faq.a: Delta’s 2024 rules allow combinations of secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies, within floodplain, coverage and parking limits. The answer depends on the lot’s zone.

faq.q: Which North Delta neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: Nordel had 12 legal-suite sales, Scottsdale 10 and Annieville 8 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do North Delta houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 35 days at a median, closing at 95.2% of list, with 6% over the list price.

This search lists detached houses for sale in North Delta that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were Nordel (75), Sunshine Hills Woods (65), Scottsdale (60), Annieville (45). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 245 detached houses that closed in North Delta between November 1 and August 31, 79 (32%) had a suite: 35 legal and 44 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $1,400,000, 14% more than the $1,225,000 median for every North Delta house.

blocks.text: Delta adopted its small-scale multi-unit housing zoning on June 24, 2024, through Bylaws 8394 and 8395. Where the zoning applies, it allows combinations of single detached dwellings, duplexes, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites.

Delta’s published guidance permits registered secondary suites and detached garden suites or coach houses on qualifying lots, subject to floodplain, coverage and parking rules. What applies to one lot depends on its zone, so confirm it with the Corporation of Delta before you price a suite as a feature.
Surrey borders North Delta, but its suite limits do not carry across the line. A listing that quotes a Surrey percentage for a Delta house is quoting the wrong city.

The MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for a detached house in North Delta was $1,159,600 in September 2026, 11.0% down over twelve months. The benchmark is the price of a typical house, not a median of sales.
Before you offer on a North Delta house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the North Delta permit and final inspection for the suite. 44 of the 79 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.
Ask whether the suite is registered with Delta and whether the lot is in a floodplain, since floodplain, coverage and parking rules all apply to suites there.
Ask which Delta zone the lot is in. The 2024 rules allow suites, coach houses and garden suites in combinations that depend on the zone, the floodplain, coverage and parking.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 35 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $1,177,500 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $1,400,000 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
